name: grieg
description: Enonic XP content, repository nodes, workflows and schedules, through the grieg MCP endpoint of your XP server.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the grieg app on an Enonic XP server. Every request goes to the endpoint you enter, with your personal key, and every tool runs as you, with your permissions. The bundle holds no key and no server address: both are asked for on install, and the key is kept in Desktop's encrypted settings.

url.description: The endpoint URL shown in the MCP tab of the Grieg admin tool.
